name: Dynatrace Log Forwarder
description: Reads messages from a Pub/Sub subscription and forwards them to the Dynatrace log ingest endpoint.

parameters.name: dynatraceApiTokenSecret
parameters.label: Dynatrace API Token Secret
parameters.helpText: Secret Manager resource name for the Dynatrace API token, e.g. projects/my-project/secrets/dynatrace-api-token/versions/latest

parameters.name: windowSeconds
parameters.label: Window Duration (seconds)
parameters.helpText: Maximum time to buffer events before flushing a partial batch.

parameters.name: batchSize
parameters.label: Batch Size
parameters.helpText: Maximum number of log events per Dynatrace ingest request.

parameters.name: maxBatchBytes
parameters.label: Max Batch Bytes
parameters.helpText: Maximum uncompressed batch size in bytes before flushing, in addition to Batch Size. Keep below the Dynatrace log ingest request limit (~50 MB).

parameters.name: deadLetterTopic
parameters.label: Dead-Letter Pub/Sub Topic
parameters.helpText: Full topic path for messages that fail to be ingested, e.g. projects/my-project/topics/dac-log-forwarder-dlq

parameters.name: maxReplayAttempts
parameters.label: Max Replay Attempts
parameters.helpText: Maximum dead-letter delivery attempts before a message is marked permanent (dt-dlq-permanent=true) and excluded from replay. Bounds replay loops.

parameters.name: replaySubscription
parameters.label: Replay Subscription (optional)
parameters.helpText: Optional subscription on the dead-letter topic, filtered to dt-dlq-permanent="false", that this same job also consumes to replay retriable failures in-place. Leave unset to disable.

parameters.name: replayBatchSize
parameters.label: Replay Batch Size
parameters.helpText: Batch size for the 2nd replay tier. Replay batch size de-escalates with retries: 1st retry uses Batch Size, 2nd uses this, 3rd+ are replayed one-by-one.

parameters.name: monitoringConfigurationId
parameters.label: Monitoring Configuration ID
parameters.helpText: Identifier sent to Dynatrace as the Dt-Configuration-Id request header on every forwarded batch.
